_comment: The ratified laguna curated-variant split: laguna-xs.2, laguna-xs-2.1 and laguna-m.1 key to THREE distinct entities, and each lab metadata row attaches to its own entity. This fixes a pre-existing SILENT metadata collision between m.1 and xs.2, so each row is load-bearing against a regression that produced no error.

provenance.ref: ratified laguna variant split: laguna-xs.2 -> laguna/xs@2

mutation.description: pins the xs variant at version 2, the half of the collision that used to lose its metadata

provenance.ref: ratified laguna variant split: laguna-xs-2.1 -> laguna/xs@2.1

mutation.description: changes only the version within the same variant, so a version-collapsing regression reddens

provenance.ref: ratified laguna variant split: laguna-m.1 -> laguna/m@1

mutation.description: changes the variant, the other half of the collision that used to steal the xs.2 metadata
